authorization_rule: Run exactly one synthetic deployment-adequacy audit on the prospectively frozen, empirical-colour-unopened RGFCA reserve after the fresh external Gate-V type-I validity confirmation passed. Use the frozen profiled-private inference without retuning. Evaluate private A=0.5,1,2,3 and shared A=2 only, 500 worlds per observed cell, with independent 1,999-world private references split into 999 profiling and 1,000 calibration draws. Preserve the result regardless of sign.
if_gate_d_fails: Preserve the failure as deployment non-qualification and do not interpret non-rejection as absence of sharedness. Do not open empirical colour outcomes under this design.
if_gate_d_passes: The frozen RGFCA reserve design is adequate for subsequent empirical TTF analysis; the Gate-D result itself is not an empirical flower-colour conclusion.
